# AS Company (Absolute Solutions SAL)

> AS Company (Absolute Solutions SAL) is Lebanon's market leader in telecommunication and electronics since 2008. The website showcases the company's services, promotes upcoming events (reservations happen over WhatsApp), and hosts a World Cup 2026 score-prediction game.

AS Company delivers telecommunication products, electronics and tech, and a trusted retail and after-sales experience across Lebanon. It also promotes live events — visitors reserve a spot by opening a pre-filled WhatsApp chat.

## Pages

- [Home](https://as.com.lb/): Overview of AS Company, featured events and what the company does.
- [What We Do](https://as.com.lb/what-we-do): The Absolute Solution division — about, vision, mission and company divisions.
- [Events](https://as.com.lb/events): Upcoming events; reserve a spot over WhatsApp.

## About

- [Telecommunication](https://as.com.lb/what-we-do): Telecom products and solutions that keep Lebanon connected.
- [Electronics & Tech](https://as.com.lb/what-we-do): The latest electronics, gadgets and accessories.
- [Retail & Support](https://as.com.lb/what-we-do): Retail experience backed by expert advice and after-sales support.
